WEEKLY SERIES · BOOK IN DEVELOPMENT

From a vague request
to a live SAP solution.

Finance requests rarely arrive as requirements. They arrive as one sentence, a comparison and a deadline. Each week I take one real SAP treasury and banking situation and work it as a recipe: Translate what the business said, Trace what is really happening in the posting data and bank files, and Transform it into a solution that goes live.

A new recipe every week on LinkedIn, building toward a book. Read the preface on LinkedIn ↗
